theory.intro: Ten per cent is one tenth, so finding $10\%$ of an amount means dividing it by $10$.
facts: Once you have $10\%$, you can double it for $20\%$ or halve it for $5\%$.
steps: Find $10\%$ by dividing the whole amount by $10$: one tenth of the whole.
For $20\%$, double the $10\%$ amount. For $5\%$, halve it.
For $15\%$, add the $10\%$ amount and the $5\%$ amount.
Keep the units and check that each share makes sense compared with its whole.

workedExamples.question_text:
Find $10\%$ of each amount.
(a) $73$ litres
(b) $6.8$ kilograms
workedExamples.solution_text:
$10\%$ is one tenth, so divide each whole by $10$.
(a) $73\div10=7.3$ litres
(b) $6.8\div10=0.68$ kilograms

workedExamples.question_text:
